technical.summary: DXCM shows solid bullish technicals with price above all major MAs and MACD crossovers, but weak trend strength (ADX 23.5) and negative CMF limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DXCM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying by junior members, broad market fear (39 Fear Greed score) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 225 crisis regime, FOMC event today) creates severe near-term headwinds despite 57-day earnings buffer and falling dollar tailwind for healthcare multinational.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD bullish crossovers on both timeframes and rising RSI across all timeframes provides solid technical setup in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 23.51), negative money flow (CMF -0.0894), no triggered strategies, extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC today), zero fundamental conviction, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — neutral entry with resistance at 121.13 limiting upside
